source_name: BQK — Lista e institucioneve financiare të licencuara/regjistruara (master licence register PDF)
why_relevant: Single authoritative roster of every bank, microfinance institution (IMF), non-bank financial institution (IFJB), insurer, broker, bureau de change (ZKV), payment institution and e-money institution licensed in Kosovo. It is the master pointer that seeds the actor map for every downstream A1 workstream cell.

source_name: BQK — Institucionet Financiare të Licencuara (licensed institutions landing page)
why_relevant: Stable landing page from which the dated licence-list PDFs and per-sector licence pages hang; the durable entry point for automated register monitoring even as file URLs rotate.

source_name: BQK — Licencimi i institucioneve financiare / Licencimi i bankave (licensing procedures & manuals)
why_relevant: Documents licence categories, entry requirements and the Banking Licensing Manual — needed to interpret what each register entry legally permits (e.g. what a payment institution vs e-money institution may do in Kosovo).

source_name: BQK — Raporti Vjetor i BQK-së (CBK Annual Report)
why_relevant: Annual narrative + data on the financial sector, supervisory activity, payment system operations and CBK governance. Carries year-on-year payment-system and banking-sector aggregates in one canonical document; also the CBK's own audited financial statements.

source_name: BQK — Raporti i Stabilitetit Financiar / Izveštaj o finansijskoj stabilnosti (Financial Stability Report)
why_relevant: The richest recurring analytical disclosure on the Kosovo banking sector: sector balance sheet, profitability, NPLs, stress tests, plus microfinance, pensions and insurance. Published in sq, sr and en with parallel numbering — ideal for multilingual term extraction.

source_name: BQK — Ostale periodične publikacije / other periodic financial-stability publications (Serbian portal)
why_relevant: Serbian-language index of the CBK's periodic financial-system publications; confirms the ?lang=sr mirror covers the full publication tree and gives Serbian-language titles for glossary building and for Serb-majority-market coverage.

source_name: BQK — Vlerësimi Tremujor i Sistemit Financiar (Quarterly Assessment of the Financial System)
why_relevant: Quarterly cadence on banking-sector developments, vulnerabilities and risks — the highest-frequency analytical read on bank performance between annual reports.

source_name: BQK — Buletini Mujor Statistikor (Monthly Statistical Bulletin)
why_relevant: Monthly since 2001; covers financial, external, fiscal and real sector statistics. Longest-running high-frequency numeric series the CBK publishes and the backbone of any Kosovo banking time-series baseline.

source_name: BQK — Monthly Information Report of the Financial System / Raporti Mujor Informativ i Sistemit Financiar
why_relevant: Monthly snapshot of the whole financial system (banks, MFIs, insurers, pensions) — faster than the quarterly assessment and useful for tracking sector-level shifts in near real time.

source_name: BQK — Seritë Kohore (Time Series database)
why_relevant: Machine-readable-ish downloadable tables: balance sheets, income statements, deposits, loans, interest rates, exchange rates for the financial and external sector. This is where commercial-bank aggregate financials that individual banks never publish comparably actually live.

source_name: BQK — Publikimi i statistikave të bankave komerciale (monthly commercial-bank statistics release)
why_relevant: Recurring news-post release announcing each month's commercial-bank statistics (assets, capital, etc.). The predictable URL slug makes it a cheap trigger for detecting that new bank-level data has landed.

source_name: BQK — Publikime statistikore dhe materiale informative nga Sistemi i Pagesave (payment-systems statistics)
why_relevant: The single richest payments-specific disclosure point: monthly and annual payment-system and payment-instrument reports — card volumes, ATM/POS terminal counts, e-banking, digital wallet transaction counts and values. Directly on-topic for the payments half of this run.

source_name: BQK — Përdorimi i kartelave në Kosovë (card usage study)
why_relevant: Standalone analytical study on card usage: ATM/POS terminal counts including Western-Balkans comparators, instrument mix, card transaction value split by terminal type, digital-wallet volumes. Exactly the kind of benchmark data a payments vendor needs and that no single bank discloses.

source_name: BQK — Mbikëqyrja e Sistemit të Pagesave / Nadgledanje platnih sistema (payment systems oversight)
why_relevant: Describes the CBK's oversight standards and the interbank payment system (SPN/SEKN — hybrid clearing and settlement of high- and low-value interbank payments) that the CBK itself operates. Establishes the infrastructure map every PSP in Kosovo must connect through.

source_name: BQK — Strategjia Kombëtare për Pagesat e Vlerës së Vogël / Nacionalna strategija za plaćanja male vrednosti (National Retail Payments Strategy)
why_relevant: Forward-looking policy document setting the CBK's retail-payments modernisation agenda — instant payments, cash displacement, PSP access. The best single signal of where Kosovo payments infrastructure procurement and regulation are heading.

source_name: BQK — Korniza ligjore: rregulloret për shërbimet e pagesave, IP-të dhe IPE-të (payment-services regulations)
why_relevant: The operative rulebook on authorisation and governance of payment institutions (IP) and e-money institutions (IPE) — defines who can enter the Kosovo payments market and on what terms. Paired with the newer regulation on non-bank PSP access to payment systems, this is the regulatory core of the payments opportunity.

source_name: Ligji Nr. 04/L-155 për Sistemin e Pagesave (Payment Systems Law, CBK-hosted copy)
why_relevant: Primary statute making the CBK the sole regulator/supervisor/operator of Kosovo's payment system, and the legal basis cited by every downstream payments regulation. Needed to anchor citation chains and to date the regime.

source_name: Ligji Nr. 03/L-209 për Bankën Qendrore të Republikës së Kosovës (Official Gazette copy)
why_relevant: The CBK's constitutive law. Article 59 is the legal obligation that forces the CBK to prepare and publish annual, quarterly and monthly financial statements under IFRS — i.e. the statutory guarantee that the disclosure stream this cell depends on will keep flowing.

source_name: Projektligji për Shërbimet e Pagesave (draft Payment Services Law, Office of the PM)
why_relevant: Draft/updated payment-services legislation (the regime referenced as Law 08/L-328) published by the Government rather than the CBK — an early-warning source on regime change (PSD2-style access, licensing of PSPs) ahead of CBK secondary regulation.

source_name: BQK — Platforma për Krahasimin e Produkteve dhe Shërbimeve Financiare (krahaso.bqk-kos.org)
why_relevant: CBK-run trilingual (sq/sr/en) web application publishing interest rates and fees for retail financial products across ~50 institutions — banks, MFIs, insurers. This is regulator-compelled per-institution pricing disclosure at a granularity no bank publishes voluntarily, and a rich structured-data target for competitive pricing intelligence.

source_name: BQK — Lajme dhe Ngjarje / News, press releases and archive
why_relevant: The event stream of the regulator: licence grants and revocations, enforcement, new platforms, data releases, governor statements. Highest-frequency signal layer and the natural trigger for re-crawling slower sources. Archive page gives historical depth.

source_name: BQK — Vendimet e Bordit / CBK Odluke Odbora (CBK Board decisions)
why_relevant: Board decisions are where licences, regulations and supervisory measures are formally adopted — the earliest machine-readable record of a licensing or regulatory change, often preceding the updated register PDF.

source_name: BQK — Pasqyrat Financiare të BQK-së (CBK's own audited financial statements)
why_relevant: IFRS financial statements of the central bank itself, externally audited and published under Article 59 of Law 03/L-209 — including monthly and quarterly statements. Useful for CBK balance-sheet and payment-system fee-revenue context.

source_name: BQK — Materiale Kërkimore / Research materials and working papers
why_relevant: CBK research papers and thematic studies (e.g. household/enterprise debt burden, methodology notes) that expose granular banking and payments data and the methodology behind published aggregates — valuable for interpreting the headline statistics correctly.

source_name: BQK — Edukimi Financiar sub-site (bqk-kos.org/edu)
why_relevant: A separate CBK sub-site with its own uploads tree that hosts plain-language explanations of licence categories (banka, IMF, IFJB, ZKV, siguruesit) and older copies of the licensed-institutions list. Useful as a glossary source and as a second, differently-indexed copy of register documents.

source_name: BQK — Departamentet e Mbikëqyrjes Financiare (supervision departments)
why_relevant: Maps the CBK's supervisory org structure (banking, MFI/NBFI, insurance, pensions) which mirrors how supervisory reports and registers are segmented — useful for routing collection and for identifying named contact points per sector.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Kosovo — Reports and Announcements (Raportet vjetore)
why_relevant: Primary IR/disclosure page of one of Kosovo's largest systemic banks; hosts annual reports 2010-2025 plus a 2022 non-financial (ESG) report as downloadable PDFs, in both Albanian and English mirrors. First-publication point for audited results, strategy statements and digital-transformation commentary.

source_name: ProCredit Bank Kosova — Publikimet financiare (Raporte vjetore / Raportet tremujore)
why_relevant: One of very few Kosovo banks publishing BOTH annual reports (2013-2025 observed) and quarterly reports ('Raportet tremujore'), plus WAIR interest-rate index and FX rates. Highest-frequency bank-own disclosure channel in the cell — best candidate for quarterly trend tracking.
